Fuel prices stable despite rising global crude oil costs

Petrol and diesel prices in India remained unchanged on July 8, despite an ongoing rally in Brent crude oil prices. This stability comes amidst escalating tensions between the US and Iran, which typically influence global oil markets. Consumers can check the latest fuel rates for major cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Kolkata.
